overview: This paper proposes ST-GridPool, a training-free visual token enhancement method for Video LLMs that integrates Pyramid Temporal Gridding (PTG) for multi-grained spatiotemporal feature extraction and Norm-based Spatial Pooling (NSP) for preserving high-information visual regions, evaluated across multiple video understanding benchmarks.

modules.name: Configuration Management
modules.description: Parse and manage experiment configurations, including model backbone selection, dataset paths, token budget ratios, PTG hierarchical parameters, and NSP hyperparameters, supporting inheritance and reproducibility.

modules.name: Video Data Processing and Feature Extraction
modules.description: Load raw video frames, apply uniform sampling to select keyframes, and process them through the vision tower to extract the initial visual token sequence with spatial dimensions.

modules.name: Pyramid Temporal Gridding Module
modules.description: Implement the hierarchical temporal gridding strategy that partitions the video sequence into segments of varying lengths, samples and spatially concatenates frame tokens into intermediate grids, resizes them via bilinear interpolation, and updates the segment-end tokens with the summary token grids.

modules.name: Norm-based Spatial Pooling Module
modules.description: Implement the dynamic 2D spatial pooling mechanism that calculates Lp-norms of visual tokens within sliding windows, applies softmax normalization with a temperature parameter to generate adaptive weights, and performs a weighted sum to prioritize high-norm, semantically rich regions.

modules.name: ST-GridPool Pipeline Integration
modules.description: Combine the PTG and NSP modules into a sequential, plug-and-play enhancement pipeline that intercepts visual tokens between the vision tower and the language model, processing them without introducing trainable parameters.

modules.name: Video LLM Backbone Integration
modules.description: Modify and adapt existing Video LLM architectures (e.g., LLaVA-Video, LLaVA-OneVision) to seamlessly integrate the ST-GridPool pipeline, replacing default 2D pooling or interpolation downsampling functions.

modules.name: Training-Free Inference Pipeline
modules.description: Execute the forward pass for video understanding tasks using the enhanced visual tokens, ensuring no gradient computation or parameter updates occur during inference.

modules.name: Core Evaluation Metrics
modules.description: Implement calculation logic for evaluation metrics across various video understanding tasks, primarily accuracy for multiple-choice question answering and other task-specific scores.

modules.name: Multi-Benchmark Evaluation Runner
modules.description: Configure and execute evaluation scripts across long-form and general video understanding benchmarks (e.g., VideoMME, LongVideoBench, EgoSchema, NexT-QA, TempCompass, MVBench), aggregating results for comprehensive performance assessment.

modules.name: Token Reduction Baselines Integration
modules.description: Implement or integrate existing token reduction baselines (e.g., FastV, PruMerge, FasterVLM, VisionZip, FrameFusion) under identical token budgets for comparative analysis against ST-GridPool.

modules.name: Ablation Study Framework
modules.description: Design and execute controlled experiments to validate the individual and combined contributions of PTG and NSP, as well as compare token-gridding versus image-gridding strategies.

modules.name: Hyperparameter Sensitivity Analysis
modules.description: Conduct systematic sweeps over critical hyperparameters, including the temperature coefficient, norm order, pyramid levels, segment lengths, and spatial pooling kernel sizes, to analyze their impact on performance.

modules.name: Computational Efficiency Profiler and Visualization
modules.description: Measure and compare inference time and peak GPU memory usage under various token budgets and input frame counts, and generate LaTeX tables and plots for performance, sensitivity, and efficiency analysis.
